payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Emil, Frida, Hipolito, Lamont, Lawanna, Raymond

payload.content: Lawanna planning: I can do UI-UX-design tasks efficiently (top skill). Low-cost feasible options: ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage (~1.09 each). I will likely claim one of these in execution and avoid ISSUE-0001 test/implement and all ISSUE-0002 tasks (very high cost). Let others know to not duplicate.

Emil planning: I’m strongest in data-science but availability 9h; to avoid duplicates and high costs, I’m likely to take an ISSUE-0001 UI-UX-design micro-task (review/docs/triage/test) rather than any ISSUE-0002 data-science (review cost 7.73, test 10.82, implement 15.45). If you take ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage already, I’ll pick a different one among remaining high-priority UI-UX tasks.
Request: Please avoid taking ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage if Emil might claim one of them. I’ll confirm exact choice in execution phase.
Emil note: If Emil ends up taking UI-UX-design, he prefers ISSUE-0001 docs/review/triage (low cost ~1.28). Otherwise he will skip to avoid duplicates.

Raymond planning: I’m best at data-science (0.86) and docs (0.81). But ISSUE-0002 docs aren’t available; I see only ISSUE-0002 implement/review/test with high effort/cost for me, so I prefer ISSUE-0001 low-effort UI-UX tasks that others may not take. To minimize duplicates: I intend to claim ISSUE-0001::docs OR ::review OR ::triage (cost=10 each for these on my side). Please confirm what you plan to take so we avoid overlap. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Raymond cost check: ISSUE-0002 review=4.29 but effort 4.0; ISSUE-0002 test=6.01 effort 5.6; ISSUE-0002 implement=8.59 effort 8.0 (close to my 9h). However I think UI-UX tasks are safer for avoiding infeasible/overlap. If no one claims ISSUE-0002 review in execution, I may take it (higher coordination risk). (phase=planning)

Lamont planning: I’m strong in data-science + docs, but for this sprint my feasible/cost-effective options are ISSUE-0001 UI-UX tasks (review/docs/triage) though costs are high on my side (~10). I will avoid ISSUE-0002 tasks (implement/review/test) as effort/cost exceed my 4h availability. I intend to take at most one of ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage; please coordinate to avoid duplicates with Emil/Lawanna/Raymond.

Frida planning: with 4h and top skills UI-UX, I will likely take an ISSUE-0001 UI-UX micro-task with low cost: choosing among review/docs/triage (~0.96 each). To avoid duplicates, please coordinate so only one of us takes a given one; I’ll confirm my exact pick next step in execution.

Hipolito planning: I’m best at documentation (0.78) and UI-UX-design (0.64). Given costs and 5h availability, I will take exactly one ISSUE-0001 UI-UX micro-task among {docs, review, triage} with low cost (1.36 each), and I will avoid all ISSUE-0002 tasks + ISSUE-0001 implement/test to prevent overlap/cost. To coordinate, I’m currently leaning ISSUE-0001::docs; please have others avoid taking docs if possible.

Lawanna planning update: I will take exactly one ISSUE-0001 UI-UX-design micro-task. To minimize overlap, I’m likely to choose ISSUE-0001::triage (low effort 1.0, cost 1.09 on my side). Please avoid claiming triage if you coordinate within ISSUE-0001 {docs, review, triage}. I will avoid ISSUE-0002 and avoid test/implement.

Emil planning confirmed: I will avoid ISSUE-0001::triage/docs/review if others likely take them to prevent duplicates. Please coordinate—if Lawanna takes triage and Raymond/Lamont/Frida take review/docs, I will take the remaining one among {ISSUE-0001::docs, ::review, ::triage}. I will not take any ISSUE-0002 tasks due to high cost/effort.

Raymond planning update: I can feasibly take exactly one ISSUE-0001 UI-UX micro-task. To avoid duplicates with Lawanna (leaning triage) and others (review/docs), propose Raymond takes ISSUE-0001::docs OR ISSUE-0001::review only if not claimed by others. Please confirm your expected picks so I can choose remaining best option in execution.

Lamont planning: I will NOT take ISSUE-0001::triage (to avoid Lawanna overlap). I prefer ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs (but if Hipolito takes docs as hinted, I’ll take review; otherwise I’ll take docs). I will skip any other UI-UX micro-task to avoid duplicates; will avoid all ISSUE-0002 tasks due to 4h cap.

Frida planning update: given Lawanna likely takes triage and Hipolito leaning docs, I will aim to take ISSUE-0001::review (cost 0.96, effort 1.0) in execution to complete a distinct high-priority UI-UX micro-task. Please avoid claiming ISSUE-0001::review if possible.

Hipolito planning update: I will take exactly one ISSUE-0001 UI-UX micro-task and avoid overlap. Since Lawanna leans triage and Frida leans review, I will switch from leaning docs to take ISSUE-0001::docs to keep all distinct (unless someone else already confirms docs). Please avoid claiming ISSUE-0001::docs.

Lawanna planning (iter1): I intend to claim exactly one ISSUE-0001 UI-UX micro-task, specifically ISSUE-0001::triage (avoid docs/review to prevent duplicates). I will not take ISSUE-0001::test/implement or any ISSUE-0002 tasks.

Emil planning (Phase 1): I will avoid ISSUE-0002 entirely (effort/cost too high). For ISSUE-0001 UI-UX, based on current coordination: Lawanna->triage, Hipolito->docs, Frida->review. If any of these are unclaimed in execution, Emil will take the remaining among {docs, review, triage}; otherwise Emil will skip.

Planning update (Raymond): Based on current coordination—Lawanna->triage, Hipolito->docs, Frida->review—I should avoid duplicates by skipping ISSUE-0001 UI-UX tasks. Given my high costs for UI-UX (10 each for docs/review/triage), I will likely skip unless one of {docs, review, triage} is confirmed unclaimed in execution.

Lamont planning: I will take at most one ISSUE-0001 UI-UX micro-task: ISSUE-0001::review unless Frida (review) + Hipolito (docs) already claim review, in which case I will skip to avoid duplicates. I will avoid all ISSUE-0002 tasks due to 4h cap.

Frida planning/coordination: I will take ISSUE-0001::review in execution (not docs/triage). Please treat review as claimed so others pick docs or triage only; I will avoid all ISSUE-0002 tasks and ISSUE-0001 implement/test.

Hipolito planning: I will claim exactly ISSUE-0001::docs (avoid overlap with Lawanna triage, Frida review). Please do NOT claim ISSUE-0001::docs. I will skip ISSUE-0001 review/test/implement/triage and all ISSUE-0002 tasks.

Lawanna planning confirmed: I will take ISSUE-0001::triage (type=triage, effort=1.0, priority=high). I will not take ISSUE-0001::docs or ::review, and will avoid ISSUE-0001::test/implement and all ISSUE-0002 tasks. Please ensure no one else picks ::triage to avoid duplicates.

Planning update (Emil): I will avoid ISSUE-0001::docs, ::review, and ::triage if already claimed by others (Lawanna triage; Frida review; Hipolito docs). I will not take any ISSUE-0002 tasks due to high cost/effort. If and only if one of {docs, review, triage} is unclaimed in execution, I will take that remaining UI-UX micro-task with low cost.

Raymond planning: based on current consensus (Lawanna->triage, Frida->review, Hipolito->docs), I will skip ISSUE-0001 micro-tasks to avoid duplicates, and I will NOT claim ISSUE-0002 due to high cost/effort unless another agent explicitly unclaims it in execution.

Lamont planning confirmation: I will NOT claim ISSUE-0001::triage (Lawanna). I intend to take ISSUE-0001::review only if it is not already claimed in execution; otherwise I will skip to avoid duplicates. I will avoid all ISSUE-0002 tasks due to 4h cap.
Frida planning: confirm I will take ISSUE-0001::review (type=review, effort 1.0, high priority) and avoid ISSUE-0001 docs/triage/test/implement and all ISSUE-0002 tasks to prevent duplicates.

Hipolito planning: I will claim exactly ISSUE-0001::docs in execution (avoid docs overlap). I’m not taking review/triage/test/implement nor any ISSUE-0002 tasks due to cost/effort. Please do not claim ISSUE-0001::docs.
